why: No major reviewer or authority answers this question in text ChatGPT can read: the three Synology PDFs are blank, Tom's Hardware is a ransomware news story, and the rest are budget-NAS roundups and homelab listicles that mention Hyper Backup in one line without naming a target box or explaining remote setup. Two niche sites (testbeforeyoubuy, ChooseCompute) get near with DS124/DS223 as a backup target but neither covers the off-site Hyper Backup Vault/rsync workflow. A focused page with a cheapest-compatible-target pick, current prices and the setup steps would stand out.
